title: QA run · area:identity-auth (23/23) · 2034975a · 2026-10-16 · 18 PASS / 5 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
QA run record for the `area:identity-auth` slice of wave #23878 (cloud runner for session `session_01K3qUoyh1xFGoWzAACPMbXJ`). Text only, per `checklist-test` §4. Selector resolved with `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs area:identity-auth --json`.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `objectstack-ai/objectstack` main @ `2034975a47193f04db4791614f4ac9331ff211d3`. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`: 75/75 tasks, 6m52s. All servers booted from a second linked worktree at the same sha (`../os-qa`) holding copies of every built `dist`.
- **Console:** `.objectui-sha` = `daeb77fc84dd824e74c95b87cdede85afdb248e7`. `pnpm objectui:build` fails on this sha (#23908, not re-filed), so the console was built in a worktree at `a35f7a67^` (`34b740f`) through `scripts/build-console.sh`, then copied in. `pnpm check:console-sha` reads `Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@daeb77fc84dd)`. **Browser verdicts ran on objectui daeb77fc built against spec `a35f7a67^`.**
- **Boots:** `OS_PORT=P pnpm exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p P -d file:DIR/data.db` from `examples/app-showcase`. Each runner group used its own ports and file DBs (47110–47161), with fresh DBs per variant. Variant env, always exported before boot:
  - `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`
  - runtime `PUT /api/settings/auth {mfa_required}`
  - `OS_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true`
  - `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_POSTURE=open` + `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_SELF_REGISTRATION_PERMISSION_SET=showcase_contributor`
  - `OS_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true` on a `--no-seed-admin` zero-user DB
  - `OS_AUTH_PHONE_NUMBER_ENABLED=true`
  - `NODE_ENV=production` + scratch `OS_AUTH_SECRET` + `OS_OIDC_PROVIDER_ENABLED=false`
  - `OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY=true`
  - `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group` / `isolated`
  - `OS_AUTH_URL` (custom issuer)
- **Scratch fixtures (never committed, no product change):**
  - A local authorization-code + PKCE (S256) OIDC provider: discovery, authorize, token, RS256 id_token with nonce, userinfo, jwks.
  - It is registered through `auth.applyConfigPatch({ oidcProviders })` from an env-gated plugin in a scratch copy of the showcase. No env switch for `oidcProviders` exists, and a config file beside the showcase config is not git-ignored.
  - Walled-tenancy boots ran from a scratch showcase copy that adds `@objectstack/organizations`.
- **Seed:** `--seed-admin` (`admin@objectos.ai`) plus the showcase demo personas. Disposable users were minted per item through invite → sign-up or `admin/create-user`; no demo persona was banned or removed.
- **Mail capture:** the persisted `sys_email` row (admin `GET /api/v1/data/sys_email`). See the checklist-accuracy notes on the close-out.
- **Browser:** Playwright with `chromium.launch({executablePath:'/opt/pw-browsers/chromium'})`. Each persona had its own context and signed in through the console form; screenshot first, then DOM. Identity was proven with `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` before each cell.
- **Execution:** six runner subagents in parallel groups, each with its own ports and DBs, at most 4 groups at once. Automated pins ran afterwards one vitest at a time (`--maxWorkers=1`), with no server up.
- **Date:** 2026-10-16, about 12:15–13:25 UTC.

## Scope

Selector `area:identity-auth` → 23 runnable items. **Planned:** none. **Blocked-hidden:** none (`--include-blocked` returns the same 23).

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/oidc-authorization-code-flow.dogfood.test.ts`: 3/3

## Reproduction rules

No clause scored `fail`, so none are owed. No authentication or authorization hole was found; nothing on this record is withheld under the RUNNER rule-2 carve-out.

## Non-pass clauses: reasons

- **`auth-method-matrix` A0, A4: blocked(environment).** Every variant that could be booted advertised and rendered exactly its config. That covers stock; phone + 2FA; production with phone on, OTP undeliverable and the OIDC provider off; a generic-OIDC fixture; and a custom issuer. The on-sides of `deviceAuthorization` and the `@better-auth/sso` plugin cannot be booted on `os dev`, so the "every variant" claim is not fully proven.
- **`self-service-profile-password` A5: blocked(fixture). N3: skipped.** The passwordless (SSO/social-only) set-initial-password branch needs a provisioned passwordless user. Contrast proven: set-initial on a user with a password → 409 `PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET`.
- **`workspace-org-switch` A5: blocked(fixture).** The server half holds: a forged `set-active` to a non-member org → 403 `USER_IS_NOT_A_MEMBER_OF_THE_ORGANIZATION`, and the active org becomes none, never the foreign org. The "UI surfaces an error" half has no UI gesture that can trigger it.
- **`admin-lifecycle-operations` N2: skipped.** Moot while `revoke-user-sessions` stays refused by design (#9969); the platform admin's 403 is recorded under A4.
- **`teams-bu-membership` N2: skipped.** No intermediate-depth BU scope was authored; the depth matrix belongs to `access-security.scope-depth-asymmetry`.

## Fixture gaps

- No provisionable passwordless user on stock showcase. This blocks `self-service-profile-password` A5/N3.
- Device authorization and the enterprise-SSO plugin have no `os dev` boot switch. This blocks `auth-method-matrix` A0/A4 on-sides.
- Generic OIDC (`oidcProviders`) has no env door. The local-IdP fixture needs a scratch app copy plus `applyConfigPatch`; the recipe is held by this runner.

Checklist-accuracy findings and fixture gaps close out on #23878. Extracted defect cards are listed in the close-out comment.
